name: corekit
description: Three plugins for Claude Code and Codex: a project workflow (corecrew), a model and effort picker (coremodel) and a second opinion from GPT (coreopinion).

plugins.name: corecrew
plugins.description: Run every project the same way: start from an interview, work with a crew of agents, keep the docs in a private repo.

plugins.name: coremodel
plugins.description: Picks the model and the effort level each prompt needs, for code and office work; asks before Fable, xhigh or max, and names the token cost of a model switch mid-chat.

plugins.name: coreopinion
plugins.description: Ask OpenAI's GPT, through the Codex CLI with a narrow read-only permission profile, for a second opinion or a review; Claude shows the answer with its own assessment and stays the only one that edits.
